meta.method: stratified Monte Carlo over compatible combo pairs; phevaluator 7-card ranks

ranked.description: top hands by equity vs a random hand, Nash's own push and call shares

tight.description: push top 20%, call top 10% at every stack

medium.description: push top 45%, call top 25% at every stack

loose.description: push top 75%, call top 45% at every stack
